This only occurs when PRNGD is used. The x86 version, which uses the built-in hardware randomizer on NonStop x86-be, passes all tests.
Is it 1.1.1r or 3.0.6 that is failing here?

3.0.6. I am testing 1.1.1r separately - The port-related changes for 1.1.1 are not in the main OpenSSL code base. Basically 3.0.6 on x86 works fine with the hardware randomizer. On ia64, we are stuck with PRNGD, and that appears to be where the breakage is.
The 1.1.1r test cycle just completed and did not show this issue on ia64.

As the 3.0.6 release was withdrawn it would be nice if we could fix this regression as well in the 3.0.7 release. However to find out the cause we would need to isolate the commit that caused this. Could you please investigate @rsbeckerca ?

I've tried to reproduce on Linux configuring --with-rand-seed=egd and running the egd.pl but the drbgtest fails the same way both on 3.0.5 and 3.0.6 so I do not see any regression. That it does not work properly is another thing but IMO no regression there.
Rerunning 3.0.5 on our ia64 to see whether it still works. More to come...
3.0.5 passes. I'm going to set up a bisect environment to see where this happens. @t8m is there a specific test command I can use for that which would help the analysis?
